definition: juicy talk about other people's private lives
description: Two animated friends at an outdoor cafe table whisper into each other's ears with shocked faces, sneak glances at an old couple at a nearby table while saying they are not looking, then sip their coffee innocently.
transcript: She told me everything. No way! Don't look now. I'm not looking!
